accessibility.evidence: Spot-checked semantic heading order, main/nav landmarks and named links. Keyboard Tab showed a 2px dark outline; Shift+Tab exposed Skip to content and Enter focused main. Enter on Architecture focused architecture-title with only Architecture current. Unknown-route home recovery focused main. Mobile navigation measured 34.5px high, with separated targets; pill links are at least 38px high. Key text contrast is recorded in contrast.json. Reduced-motion CSS was inspected; OS preference switching and real screen-reader testing were not performed.

responsive.evidence: Rendered home at CSS viewports 390x844, 768x1024 and 1440x1000. Checked home/contact at 320x740 and the 767px breakpoint edge. No horizontal page overflow was observed. All three major sections have twelve computed columns and 3/9 spans at desktop/tablet width; at 767px they switch to block flow with static labels. At desktop, a scrolled project label remained 32px from the top within its own section. Inter and JetBrains Mono and the exact #FAF9F6 background were confirmed through computed styles. Some screenshot exports are provider-scaled below the measured CSS viewport dimensions.

loading.evidence: Static copy renders directly, with locally hosted font-face swap. The lazy Taskly screenshot retains intrinsic 1280x631 dimensions and renders in the browser frame; no artificial loading overlay is added.

empty.reason: The static portfolio has no search/filter or remote collection. It contains one feature and one secondary project; no empty placeholder card is rendered after the user excluded Ghost.

error.evidence: /not-a-page displayed No page here and a keyboard-operable home recovery. A separate local fixture deliberately returned 404 for the JPEG and displayed Screenshot unavailable inside the frame.

partial.evidence: During screenshot failure the engineering case study, live app, source and text remained available, while the unusable full-size image link was hidden. Wyag has source and tutorial attribution without a fabricated live-demo button.

success.evidence: Projects and Architecture reached their correct destinations; active navigation was singular. /projects redirects to /#projects, legacy BK-001 opens Taskly, BK-103 and /projects/wyag reach Wyag. Header Resume opened a PDF tab; HTTP verification returned application/pdf, 80966 bytes, matching the original supplied file by SHA-256. Contact shows the expected email and destinations. The 2027 availability is present and Ghost/old availability/geographic labels are absent from the production bundle.

permission.reason: No portfolio account, upload, payment, form submission or permission flow exists. Resume is a static PDF link and email uses mailto; no message was sent.

renderedEvidence.observation: Final desktop hero, requested chips, green-dot 2027 availability, navigation and the start of the split Experience section.
At the exact tablet breakpoint the header fits and Experience retains twelve columns with a 3/9 split.
Mobile brand/name and Resume share the first row; four navigation links sit below; hero and 2x2 action chips wrap cleanly.
Taskly feature has a white border container, challenge callout, three prominent actions and framed actual screenshot.
Wyag is the single secondary card with attribution. Education and technical stack align side by side; the Projects label remains bounded and sticky.
Taskly card text, tags, challenge and primary action fit within the phone content width.
Keyboard navigation reaches the labelled Architecture section, and the command flow stacks on mobile.
Extra-narrow header navigation, Resume pill and long email fit without horizontal overflow.
The intentional image 404 preserves framed fallback text and all project actions, with no broken enlargement link.
Keyboard skip link is exposed; activating it focuses main rather than skipping the hero actions.

validation: No console error/warning entries on the reviewed ordinary routes
PDF and production-content checks saved in content-checks.json
limits: No full accessibility certification, screen-reader session, OS reduced-motion toggle or field-performance measurement.
The user supplied the stronger experience copy and stack; delivery claims are not independently verified by this website change.
Taskly and Wyag repositories were not changed or executed.
No production deployment: review branch and draft PR only.
